title: Construct a native covariant action on the full dirty reader
body:
The published dyadic lift of the selected 8-by-704 dirty reader left its native frame alignment unpaid. I construct a changed source/query action whose native alignment uses only monomials. I couple the two query four-cycles to one binary orthogonal payload map and place a reversible dyadic chart in eight zero-frame helpers.

For the actual framed reader `R`, the literal actions satisfy `RP=GR` and `P^4=G^4=I` on arbitrary dirty, correlated inputs. I preserve 584 outputs at every prefix and restore all 704 inputs through the inverse or fourth power. The action is nonunitary and changes 112 X fields plus eight helper fields; it uses a different query generator from the predecessor's `Q tensor I`.

Each input orientation costs 1316 scalar field operations and 120 native monomials, with zero positive-rank Fourier children. At the retained arithmetic tariff I charge 9748 real scalar primitives. An output-phase action additionally costs 24 scalar operations and eight monomials. I retain physical movement and placement as separate obligations.

I passed the registered CPython 3.12.13 normal and optimized replays:

- Forward/backward reconstruction of the actual reader and all 704 dirty-input columns over `Q[z]/(z^4-1)`.
- Both literal inverse orders, fourth power, and both orientations at each phase; amplitude allowance 374 and one extra fractional bit for these local words.
- All 112 source adapters/data blocks and eight output blocks, with signed Pauli images and exact 512-entry state images for global phase.
- Coherent omitted-helper, lost-sign, wrong-orientation, lost-phase and uncompute controls. The wrong payload orientation has rank two at each centre.

I retain the original eight H8 centre descents, rank mass 64. I close a native-interface obligation under the changed generator and leave centre-child deletion, supplier admission and formal-kernel verification open. I retain the selected exponent. Before further construction, identify the requested gather/centre/scatter output and give its complete deleted/added-child bill. I explain the typed-echo and transported-ERASE limits in the proof.

I credit ywz65's full-reader analysis and known signed data permutation, Ross Richardson's dyadic section and typed-child audit, and Ali Romman's unchanged exact Clifford compiler/interpreter. NOTICE/SOURCES retain exact pins and the selected-word lineage. Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

Claim and revision 5 expansion decision: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2488#discussioncomment-18955479
